Name: Better Geode Crusher
Author: lizzoli
Description: This mod uses Content Patcher to allow you to use the geode crusher to open Artifact Troves, Golden Coconuts, Mystery Boxes, and Golden Mystery Boxes. These are tagged as excluded by the geode crusher by default - this mod removes the tag on these items. This does not impact using geodes in the geode crusher. This mod is fully compatible with Automate.

Downloads.Description: Allows the Geode Crusher to open Artifact Troves and Golden Coconuts. Temporarily removed mystery box functionality while updating.
